comments.body: I have been living in Lausanne for 3 years.. the problem is that in the French-speaking area they only speak French and do not make great efforts to understand you.. so either you speak well or they do not waste time.. I come from a country where you try to understand each other even with gestures.. not here.. in fact I see that even if I say a word correctly but the phonetics is not perfect they do not strive to understand.. try to socialize with people who speak English well at the beginning and try to learn French if you want to integrate .. good luck!
comments.author: Imax1003
